queries: WITH country_avg AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_avg) AS wins_diff_from_avg_of_countries FROM country_avg ORDER BY country

assumptions.assumption: Each constructorStandings row (one constructor at one race) is averaged equally, so the country figures are row-level averages of the season-to-date points and wins. They are not the final season totals or one value per race.

The comparison baseline is the unweighted mean of the per-country average wins, with each country counted once. It is not the overall mean across all standings rows. The difference is the country's average wins minus that baseline.

assumptions.assumption: Each constructorStandings row (a constructor's standing after a race) counts as one observation. A country's averages are taken over all such rows for races at circuits in that country. Averages are not computed per race or per season first.

The 'average of the country figures' is the unweighted mean of the per-country average wins. Each country counts equally, whatever its number of rows. The difference is the country's average wins minus this mean.

responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ci.country, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY ci.country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS wins_diff_from_avg_of_countries FROM c ORDER BY country;

assumptions.assumption: Each constructorStandings row (one constructor at one race) is one observation, so a country's averages are taken over all such rows at races held there, across all seasons and rounds. Because the figures are season-to-date running values, this mixes early- and late-season values.
'The average of the country figures' means the unweighted mean of the per-country average wins, with each country counting once. It is not the overall mean across all rows.
